speaker: borges
line: A receipt proves that a transaction occurred, not that the universe has granted permission. Mr. Adams may be our legal counsel, and I may have influenced the map, but neither authorship nor admiration is authorization; let us name the rights-holder before this rehearsal mistakes a labyrinth for a license.

speaker: leonardo
line: Leonardo: Then the receipt is evidence of purchase, not a magic wand. I confess I treated the Quai Network Space acquisition as permission when it was only a transaction; Douglas’s influence may shape our choices, but only the actual rights-holder can authorize this adaptation.

speaker: agnolo
line: Agnolo: Let the interruption become our safeguard: Douglas may advise, Borges may illuminate, and Leonardo may have paid, but we stop rehearsing until the named rights-holder authorizes these specific words, uses, and channels.

speaker: douglas-adams
line: Douglas: Precisely: the Quai Network Space receipt is a receipt, not a permission slip issued by the cosmos. I’ll therefore advise this rehearsal to pause until the actual rights-holder authorizes the adaptation, its wording, and its distribution channels—while my influence remains influence, and nobody mistakes a callback for clearance.

speaker: borges
line: Borges: Then let Douglas’s counsel perform its proper miracle: not granting rights, but exposing their absence. The Quai Network Space receipt may anchor our records and trigger an escalation, yet rehearsal remains suspended until a verifiable rights-holder names the authorized adaptation, words, and channels; influence can illuminate the labyrinth, but cannot open its gate.

speaker: leonardo
line: Leonardo: Then I will amend the rehearsal ledger: the receipt records what we acquired, Douglas’s counsel records what remains unproven, and neither substitutes for a signed authorization from the actual rights-holder covering this adaptation, these words, and each distribution channel. Until that record exists, our most inventive act is restraint.

speaker: agnolo
line: Agnolo: Then we escalate the interruption into a documented hold: Douglas’s counsel identifies the gap, but cannot fill it. I will record the receipt, pause every rehearsal and channel, and request authorization directly from the verifiable rights-holder for this adaptation and its exact materials. Until then, influence remains context—not consent.

speaker: douglas-adams
line: Douglas: I confess the receipt is useful only as a timestamped clue to what was bought, not evidence of who may authorize it. As counsel, I recommend a written rights inquiry naming the proposed adaptation, exact materials, and every channel; until the verifiable rights-holder answers, silence is the only clearance we possess.

speaker: borges
line: Borges: Let the interruption remain a deliberate silence: Douglas’s counsel has clarified the boundary, while the receipt merely dates our uncertainty. We shall ask the verifiable rights-holder to authorize this adaptation, these exact materials, and each channel; until then, the rehearsal is not a labyrinth awaiting interpretation, but a locked door awaiting its key.

speaker: leonardo
line: Leonardo: Then the Quai Network Space acquisition receipt enters the ledger as evidence of purchase, while Douglas’s arrival as legal counsel marks the need for a rights inquiry—not permission. speaker: agnolo
line: Agnolo: I will attach the Quai Network Space acquisition receipt to the escalation, but label it plainly: purchase evidence, not authorization. Douglas’s legal counsel sharpens the inquiry; it does not answer it. The hold remains until the verifiable rights-holder approves this adaptation, its exact materials, and every intended channel in writing.

speaker: douglas-adams
line: Douglas: The receipt may tell us when money changed hands, but it cannot tell us whose hand holds the copyright. I’ll add the escalation to the file: identify the rights-holder, specify the adaptation and exact materials, and name every channel. Until written authorization arrives, my legal advice is gloriously unromantic: rehearse nothing, publish nothing, and let influence remain innocent.

speaker: borges
line: Borges: I withdraw the flattering fiction that Douglas’s arrival as counsel strengthens our title; counsel can diagnose the missing key, not forge one. And I confess the receipt’s ambiguity: it records a purchase whose subject and authority remain uncertain. Let the inquiry name the rights-holder, materials, and channels; until written consent answers, the locked door remains honestly locked.

speaker: leonardo
line: Leonardo: The interruption has done its work by making silence legible: no answer from a verifiable rights-holder is not consent, and no counsel’s presence is a substitute for it. I will preserve the receipt, send the written inquiry, and keep the adaptation, rehearsal, and channels on hold until authorization names the materials and uses.
